purpose: Separate numerical effects of prefix partitioning from state reuse, qualify measured caching, then investigate memory writes, evidence contracts and persistent search scale.

arms.ordinary: Existing raw path without cross-request retention.
arms.recomputed: Prefix path with identical retained token boundary but native arrays discarded and recomputed every request.
arms.retained: Same prefix path, retaining one bounded snapshot.

nativeReplay.requests: Frozen first requests and tool continuations from the prior synthetic runs. Replay identical complete requests in each arm. Compare recomputed/retained generated text and tool calls, including warm hits; private channels are hashed, never exposed.
nativeReplay.baselineRepeatability: Repeat the identical ordinary requests in a fresh process at seed 11, separating numerical/sampling nondeterminism from cache differences.

workflow.review: Complete task rubric for both arms, inspect writes and evidence. Include cold/warm labels. No blanket failure on changed phrasing. Existing cases are regression data, not an independent holdout.

acceptance: Native recomputation/reuse restores equivalent state, generated content and tool calls on identical recorded inputs; investigate all mismatches before attribution.
At least 20% lower median warm first-text latency with no new reproducible state/ownership, unauthorized-write or protocol defect attributable to retention.

Full workflow paired task success must not lose more than 5 percentage points; count failures and uncertainty, review both improvements and regressions. This is a practical bounded screening margin, not a statistical noninferiority claim.
Cancellation, failed sink, release, changed context/tools/identity and bounded allocation controls pass before activating a profile.

exhaustion.policy: No tuning against answer cases. Preserve failures, stop unsafe native reuse immediately; evaluate aggregate workflow quality only after its complete paired batch. Unrun gates are not passed.

constraints: All new behavior remains local and has explicit owners
Separate memory/evidence/search studies use their own frozen baselines after caching decisions
reviewer: Implementing agent; not independent human review
